rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A WordPress MCP server built by Rahees Ahmed that provides 49+ tools for complete WordPress site management through AI agents. Built with TypeScript and the quickmcp-sdk, it integrates with the WordPress REST API to enable comprehensive content operations including posts, pages, media uploads, user management, comments, categories, tags, plugins, themes, menus, and site settings. The server uses Basic authentication with WordPress application passwords and includes robust error handling, input validation through Zod schemas, and helper functions for formatting WordPress objects, making it useful for AI-powered WordPress automation, content management workflows, and building intelligent WordPress administration tools.
